notes.title: Footsteps And Balancing Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36930309/7090ebc850720e356e593820ef2ba31d61b931e7.jpg[/img]




Hi everyone

Here is what has been done in this update

[b][u]New Footstep system [/u][/b]\

[u]Sounds:[/u]

Wood
Sand
Metal
Gravel
Concrete
Grass

[b][u]Loot Balancing [/u][/b]

Scrap was added as a very needed item to craft weapons.
Some Weapons are more expensive than others as the damage on them is more.
You can find scrap in loot boxes at loot areas
Grade A cloth can be found on animals as well as leather to craft better gear sets

[u][b]Door Locks[/b][/u]

New Key Lock was added including the code lock, The key lock is cheaper to craft than the code lock. Keys to be made in a later stage where you will be able to craft a key for your friend on multiplayer, the option was added already.

[b][u]Optimization [/u][/b]

Graphics was optimized for both performance and quality.
If you are into pvp and raiding now is the time to dust off that DPI mouse and get your game on

[u][b]Steam Trailer for community [/b][/u]

If you make a good clip ingame you can send it to me in discord: https://discord.gg/e6cSHzM  and I will use it for one of the trailers in the steam page and ingame start of game.

[b][u]Save System[/u][/b]

Save system was fixed with sometimes not saving correctly.
Server and single player will save every 20 min but make sure if you log off on single player and multiplayer servers or co - op to save your game.
You can move your Single Player save game and use it with everything you have in single player over to CO - OP and play with a friend

[b][u]UI[/u][/b]

Changes was made to the UI in the main menu and ingame character inventory.

[u][b]Durability [/b][/u]

Axe, PickAxe And IceAxe has durability added to them where you can repair them before they brake. the health on the tools is 100HP. hover over the tool to see the health out of 100/100

[b][u]Name Tags[/u][/b]

Name Tags with chat by pressing enter was added.
Multiplayer players can now see your steam name above your head.
Single player name tag is to find your dead body on the map when you died as well as Multiplayer

Chat can be seen by other players above your head and voice chat by pressing C

[b][u]Update to come[/u][/b]

[u]Berries: [/u]

New berries are coming to the next update that can boost your stamina and some berries are dangerous but might take away that hunger so enjoy the easy berries find now as berries wont be so easy to find in the next update with the new berries to come and stamina and hunger will be optimized accordingly  

[b][u]Building:[/u][/b]

Working on new build parts like pillars, will have more on that soon

[b][u]Level, mission and XP system[/u][/b]

Working on a level system that will level your rank that you see next to your name tag in yellow.

Mission system will help Noobs to get started and harvesting will add xp to your level.
With each level you will get XP and with the XP you will gain more stamina and when you reach a certain
XP you will unlock a rear steam gift. This will come very soon.

[b][u]
Swimming [/u][/b]

Swimming will be added very soon as I already started working on the animations and already added the animations. Busy working on the code and will have it ready very soon

If you find any Bugs and glitches please report it to my discord: https://discord.gg/e6cSHzM

Thank you and have a LEKKER Day
MeanDean Studio's

Here is what comes in the next update later today or tomorrow!


[b][u]Elephants[/u][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36930309/f6189d138a7e24f3738ca3e639b5270fff1401f3.png[/img]


Elephants will give you 50 normal cloth, 50 Grade A Cloth and 10 Raw Meat when you Hunt them down.

[b][u]The Rhino[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36930309/ba09052533e68cd13925b3fa4fb731ecfa2f83e7.png[/img]


Very Sneaky animal and can be found in trees and mountain sides. You wont always see them before they attack you, You will get 50 normal cloth, 100 Grade A cloth and 5 meat from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36930309/832a54aa88fc635495f05554eb3820ff13e013f6.png[/img]

Hi everyone


OK......Where to start.
This is a big update and allot of fixes and new stuff was added to the game, so here is what I have done.
[b][u]
Farming system[/u][/b]

New farming system was added where you can now craft your own planters and farm houses to plant your own fiber and grow them. These fiber plants will later be Grade A Fiber in the next update to craft higher tear loot. To craft Planters go to the workbench and craft the planters and place them anywhere inside your base or around your base or in the Planter Farming house that you can also craft on the workBench. Look at the planter and press E to interact and plant the seed, now you will need a water bottle to water the plant so it can grow so make sure to craft one and press E on planter and give it water and you will see your fiber grow.
